title: Unused module-level get_db() helper
evidence: app.py:8-13 defines get_db(); create_app uses its own _conn() (app.py:57-62) instead, so get_db() is dead code
suggestion: Delete get_db() or route _conn() through it to avoid duplication

title: No-op before_request handler
evidence: app.py:53-55 registers @app.before_request _set_db_path with an empty body (pass)

title: Author filter is exact-match only
evidence: app.py:103-105 uses WHERE author = ? (spec only requires ?author= filter, so this satisfies R3)
suggestion: Optional: support case-insensitive or substring matching

title: PUT allows partial updates beyond spec
evidence: app.py:126-129 defaults each field to the existing row value, enabling partial PUT (exercised by test_update_book, test_app.py:73)
suggestion: None — reasonable behavior, noted as enhancement
